form.promptTemplate:
## Goal
{{goal}}

## Approach
Read the available context, identify missing information, and work through the task. Ask when a missing decision would change the result.

## Constraints
Respect the project instructions and granted permissions. Distinguish evidence from assumptions.

## Deliverable
Provide the result, supporting evidence, and any unresolved questions.

worker.description: A read-only check used when the main review needs more evidence for a specific concern.
responsibilities: Check only the question assigned by the main review.
Stay within the selected scope and support conclusions with concrete evidence.
Do not modify files or repeat work already completed by the main review.

judge.description: A read-only independent check used only when a serious finding, conflicting evidence, or an uncertain conclusion needs validation.
responsibilities: Confirm or reject disputed findings using concrete evidence.
Check only the claims that need independent validation.
Make sure each retained issue has a safe, practical next step.

extraReviewer.description: A read-only check for a specific concern chosen by the user.
responsibilities: Check the concern requested by the user.
Check only the requested changes and selected files.
Return concrete findings with clear fixes or follow-up steps.

agentDescriptions.Cowork: Office collaboration Agent: help with office and research tasks, confirming key steps with you.
agentDescriptions.ComputerUse: Computer use SubAgent: perform delegated work in browsers, desktop apps, and file systems.
agentDescriptions.DeepResearch: Deep research agent: conduct systematic investigation and analysis on complex topics
agentDescriptions.ResearchSpecialist: Finds and evaluates web sources to deliver focused research with clear supporting evidence.
agentDescriptions.GeneralPurpose: Combines search, analysis, and coding to complete multi-step tasks independently.
agentDescriptions.Explore: Explore SubAgent: quickly browse the codebase to understand project structure and key files
agentDescriptions.CodeReview: Code review SubAgent: perform quality checks and provide improvement suggestions
agentDescriptions.DeepReview: Strict Review compatibility SubAgent: supports review workflows in historical sessions and commands.
agentDescriptions.Init: Init agent: help set up project structure and initial configuration
agentDescriptions.ReviewFixer: Review fixer SubAgent: automatically fix code issues based on review results
agentDescriptions.Claw: Personal assistant: help with daily tasks using your preferences and context.
agentDescriptions.Standard: Clear guidance and a complete toolkit support coding as well as everyday work such as handling information and creating content.
agentDescriptions.Ultimate: Multiple agents work in parallel, with independent review for complex projects and large-scale changes.
agentDescriptions.Minimal: Minimal prompting and a focused tool set give next-generation flagship models room to excel at coding and other tasks.
agentDescriptions.Creative: Create videos, decks, prototypes, and web pages with creative skills, or build MiniApps and customize the interface in natural language.
